answer: BIOM 417 Critical Care Equipment, 3(3,0): medical equipment in surgical theaters, ICUs and emergency departments - interpreting outputs, simulating system function, handling failures, upgrades and a team design project for high-risk medical technology. Prerequisite: BIOM 311.

answer: BIOM 418 Clinical Laboratory Instruments, 3(3,0): clinical laboratory instruments for analyzing specimens - spectrophotometry, flame photometers, spectrofluorometry, chemistry and hematology analyzers, and chromatography. Prerequisite: BIOM 311.

answer: BIOM 421 Medical Imaging, 3(3,0): X-ray generation and interaction, attenuation, filters, collimators, grids, fluoroscopy, resolution, and ultrasound generation, transducers, modes and Doppler. Prerequisite: PHYS 312.

source_quote: This course introduces basic computational methods for understanding what nervous
answer: BIOM 440 Computational Neuroscience, 3(3,0): computational methods for nervous systems - neural coding, dynamics, learning and memory, spiking neurons, neural networks and graph theory, with MATLAB/Python exercises. Prerequisites: BIOM 312 and MATH 311.

source_quote: This CO-OP work experience is designed to provide students with an eight-week
answer: BIOM 499 Co-op Work Experience, 3(3,0): an eight-week placement in biomedical engineering with a report, poster and PowerPoint presentation. Prerequisites: ENGL 217; Senior Standing.

answer: BIOM 519 Advanced Therapeutic Devices, 3(3,0): hemodialysis, hemofiltration and hemodiafiltration, ventilators and modes, respiratory modeling and spirometry, and other advanced therapeutic devices. Prerequisite: BIOM 414.

answer: BIOM 522 Advanced Medical Imaging, 3(3,0): tomographic modalities and slice reconstruction - MRI, CT, nuclear medicine, PET and SPECT (k-space, relaxation, contrast, artifacts, scintillation). Prerequisite: BIOM 421.

source_quote: This course presents the mission, objectives, and responsibilities of biomedical
answer: BIOM 531 Clinical Engineering, 3(3,0): the mission and responsibilities of biomedical engineering in healthcare institutions and effective use of hospital technology. Prerequisites: BIOM 417 and BIOM 421.

source_quote: The first phase of a team-oriented, project-based experience that culminates in the
answer: BIOM 595A (1(1,0), prerequisite ENGL 217) and BIOM 595B (3(3,0), prerequisite BIOM 595A) are the two phases of the biomedical BE team project creating a device with proposal, solution, report, presentation and demonstration.

source_quote: This course addresses radio-frequency design and applications in biomedical
answer: BIOM 402 Radio Frequency Applications in Biomedical Engineering, 3(3,0), a biomedical technical elective: RF design, coupling, modulation, transmitters and receivers, with applications in telemetry, transcutaneous power, hyperthermia, RF ablation and tagging. Prerequisite: CCEE 331.

answer: BIOM 498 Special Topics in Biomedical Engineering, 3(3,0): current special topics selected by the instructor and department.

answer: BIOM 501 Emerging Healthcare Technologies, 3(3,0), a biomedical technical elective: latest bioengineering innovations and their impact, including endoscopy, brain mapping, heat therapy and advanced vital-signs measurement.

source_quote: This course introduces artificial intelligence (AI) and its applications in healthcare,
answer: BIOM 502 AI Applications in Healthcare, 3(3,0), a biomedical technical elective: AI, machine learning and precision medicine for assessing clinical datasets, disease management and patient engagement.

answer: BIOM 504 Bio-Image Processing, 3(3,0), a biomedical technical elective: image enhancement, 2-D DFT, spatial and frequency filtering, binary processing, edge detection, segmentation and video basics using MATLAB. The description lists CCEE 321 as prerequisite.

source_quote: This course introduces mathematical tools and algorithms implemented to simulate
answer: BIOM 505 Computer Simulations for Life Sciences, 3(3,0), a biomedical technical elective: modeling and simulating biological and medical processes with MATLAB/Simulink and LabVIEW, compartments, parameter estimation and prediction.

source_quote: and bone substitutes. Research applications include aiding in the diagnosis of
answer: BIOM 506 Biomaterials, 3(3,0), a biomedical technical elective: cell-surface interactions, signal transduction, biomaterial polymers, ceramics and bone substitutes, tumor diagnosis and nano-coatings for devices. Prerequisite: BIOM 311.

source_quote: This course is designed to enable students to review the main fluids of the human
answer: BIOM 507 Bio-fluids, 3(3,0), a biomedical technical elective: bodily fluids, fluid mechanics basics, blood properties, gas exchange and transport, and hemodynamics of large arteries.

source_quote: This course explains the architecture of microcontroller-based systems: registers,
answer: BIOM 508 Microcontroller and Embedded Systems for Biomedicine, 3(3,0), a biomedical technical elective: microcontroller architecture, timers, interrupts, serial/parallel communication, ADC, PIC 16F84/16F877, MPLAB, Proteus and mikroC. Prerequisite: CCEE 426.

source_quote: This course will focus on the human musculoskeletal system. It emphasizes various
answer: BIOM 512 Biomechanics and Rehabilitation Engineering, 3(3,0), a biomedical technical elective: engineering principles of bone, cartilage, ligaments, tendons and muscle, viscoelasticity, EMG and rehabilitation mechanics. Prerequisites: CIVE 211 and BIOM 311.

source_quote: This course enables the students to study the basic principles of hemodynamics
answer: BIOM 513 Hemodynamics Measurement, 3(3,0), a biomedical technical elective: invasive and non-invasive measurement of blood flow, pressure, compliance and resistance, and cardiopulmonary function measures.

source_quote: This course emphasizes current applications of telecommunications in medical
answer: BIOM 521 Introduction to E-Health Care, 3(3,0), a biomedical technical elective: telecommunications in diagnosis and patient care and remote patient management with wireless, mobile and robotic technologies. Prerequisite: BIOM 421.

source_quote: This course provides students with the technical knowledge and skills necessary to
answer: BIOM 532 Biomedical Servicing, 3(3,0), a biomedical technical elective: installing, troubleshooting, testing and repairing electro-medical systems, preventive maintenance, calibration, supply management and equipment accreditation.

source_quote: This course presents procedures followed for medical and health services
answer: BIOM 533 Health-care Facility Management, 3(3,0), a biomedical technical elective: health services management, administrator duties, workflow, credentials, quality control, HR, finance, insurance, sterilization and infection control.

answer: BIOM 597 Advanced Topics in Biomedical Engineering, 3(3,0): an advanced biomedical topic defined by the instructor and approved by the department chair. Prerequisite: Senior Standing.
